sentences.content: Will we be able to live on earth in 100 years?
sentences.english: Will we be able to live on earth in 100 years ?
sentences.chinese: 100年后我们还能在地球上生存吗？

sentences.content: I believe people will make the earth a better place.
sentences.english: I believe people will make the earth a better place
sentences.chinese: 我相信人们会让地球变得更美好。

sentences.content: Will many people live in outer space?
sentences.english: Will many people live in outer space ?
sentences.chinese: 会有很多人生活在太空吗？

sentences.content: What will the future be like?
sentences.english: What will the future be like ?

sentences.content: There will be more people in cities, but there will be fewer traffic accidents.
sentences.english: There will be more people in cities , but there will be fewer traffic accidents
sentences.chinese: 城市中的人口将会增加，但交通事故会减少。

sentences.content: Students probably won't go to a school in the future.
sentences.english: Students probably won't go to a school in the future
sentences.chinese: 学生们未来可能不会去学校上学了。

sentences.content: They will study at home or any place they want.
sentences.english: They will study at home or any place they want
sentences.chinese: 他们可以在家或任何想去的地方学习。

sentences.content: Because we'll have better health care technology in our homes.
sentences.english: Because we'll have better health care technology in our homes
sentences.chinese: 因为我们家中将拥有更先进的医疗保健技术。

sentences.content: Machines will tell us how to solve small health problems before they become bigger.
sentences.english: Machines will tell us how to solve small health problems before they become bigger
sentences.chinese: 机器会在小健康问题恶化之前告诉我们如何解决。

sentences.content: How long will most people live?
sentences.english: How long will most people live ?

sentences.content: Well, more people will live to be over 100 years old.
sentences.english: Well , more people will live to be over 100 years old
sentences.chinese: 嗯，会有更多人活到100岁以上。

sentences.content: Some may even live to be 150.
sentences.english: Some may even live to be 150
sentences.chinese: 有些人甚至可能活到150岁。
